authRedesign.title: Sign in
authRedesign.subtitle: Your records, appointments and Health ID — protected on this device.
authRedesign.clinicianBody: Use your work email and password above. We recognise staff accounts and open the clinician workspace.
authRedesign.trust: End-to-end encrypted · Data stays in Cameroon

medicalId.title: Medical ID
medicalId.subtitle: Shown because the owner of this phone chose to.

signOut.title: Sign out of OpesCare?
signOut.body: Here is what happens on this phone:
signOut.point1: Your session ends and the access token is removed.
signOut.point2: Offline copies of your records, unsent changes and downloaded PDFs are wiped.
signOut.point3: Phone alerts for this account stop on this device.
signOut.pointEmergency: Your Medical ID stays on the sign-in screen — turn it off in Settings.
signOut.failed: Could not sign out. Check your connection and try again.

signedOut.title: You are signed out
signedOut.body: Nothing from your session is left on this phone.

settings.toggleTitle: Show emergency info on the sign-in screen
settings.toggleBody: Blood group, age, allergies and your emergency contact appear on the sign-in and lock screens. Anyone holding this phone can see them.
settings.enabledNote: Saved on this device only. Updated each time your profile refreshes.
